tree.heading: Public Meetings and Release of Public Versions of Reports.—

children.text: hold public hearings and meetings to the extent appropriate; and
release public versions of the reports required under this chapter.

tree.heading: Public Hearings.—
tree.text: Any public hearings of a Commission shall be conducted in a manner consistent with the protection of information provided to or developed for or by the Commission as required by any applicable statute, regulation, or Executive order.
